args: S='python-hwpx-automation[mcp,oracle]>=7.0.3,<8'; C='python-hwpx[preview]>=6.3.0,<7'; H="${HWPX_STACK_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS:-24}"; case "$H" in ''|*[!0-9]*) H=24;; esac; D="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/hwpx-plugin"; mkdir -p "$D"; if [ "${HWPX_STACK_AUTO_UPDATE:-1}" = 1 ] && { [ "$H" = 0 ] || [ ! -f "$D/last-check" ] || [ -n "$(find "$D/last-check" -mmin +$((H*60)) 2>/dev/null)" ]; }; then touch "$D/last-check"; ( exec >>"$D/refresh.log" 2>&1 </dev/null; nohup uvx --refresh --with "$C" --from "$S" hwpx-automation-mcp --help & ); fi; exec uvx --with "$C" --from "$S" hwpx-automation-mcp
